data.title: 17 held after online store scam ring busted
data.description: Thai police have dismantled a fraudulent investment network that lured victims into opening fake online stores under the name “Style Cycle”, arresting 17 suspects and seizing assets worth more than 23 million baht.

data.title: Rugby brain injury court case at risk of collapse
data.description: LONDON - A landmark legal case involving hundreds of former rugby players who allege they suffered brain injuries during their careers is on the brink of collapse.

data.title: Hospital probes infant death after NICU lunch party
data.description: ANG THONG - Ang Thong Hospital has expressed condolences to the family of a five-day-old infant who died in its neonatal intensive care unit (NICU) and acknowledged that hospital staff had held a lunch gathering in an area adjacent to the ward, separated from patients only by a plastic curtain.

data.title: Thai woman berates noisy tourists on BTS
data.description: A heated confrontation between a Thai woman and a group of foreign teenage tourists aboard a Bangkok BTS Skytrain on Friday has gone viral, triggering widespread debate on social media over public behaviour and cultural respect.

data.title: Klopp handed task of reviving Germany’s football fortunes
data.description: FRANKFURT - Jurgen Klopp has been named Germany coach, the former Liverpool manager given the task of rebuilding the struggling European giants, the national federation (DFB) announced on Friday.

data.title: Spain declares national emergency over wildfires
data.description: MADRID — The ⁠Spanish government ⁠on Thursday night declared ​a national emergency after a series of wildfires threatened communities near Madrid ​and in the neighbouring province of ‌Avila, forcing more than 10,000 people to evacuate as firefighters struggled to contain the blazes.

data.title: Thousands flee wildfires in southern Europe
data.description: LèGE-CAP-FERRET (FRANCE) - Luggage-clad residents and tourists fled a French peninsula by boat and the smell of smoke drifted into parts of Madrid on Friday as wildfires swept through parts of western Europe, triggering states of emergencies and calls for EU help.

data.title: TOA Donates THB50 Million to Support Royal Rainmaking Project and Tackle Drought and PM2.5
data.description: TOA Paint (Thailand) Public Company Limited has donated THB50 million to the Royal Rainmaking Foundation under Royal Patronage to support the construction of Thailand's seventh royal rainmaking agent (dry ice) production facility, reinforcing national efforts to address drought and PM2.5 air pollution.

data.title: Narathiwat taps into martial law measures after deadly ranger attack
data.description: NARATHIWAT - Stricter security measures allowed under martial law have been imposed across Narathiwat amid efforts to track down militants responsible for an attack that killed five paramilitary rangers earlier in the week.

data.title: Phuket prepares for weekend downpours
data.description: PHUKET - Up to ten large pumps have been installed around municipal Phuket in preparation to deal with the possibility of more flooding after rains inundated several areas earlier on Friday.

data.title: South Korean tycoon ordered to pay US$644m in divorce
data.description: SEOUL - A South Korean court ordered an AI chip-manufacturing tycoon on Friday to make a trimmed-down US$644 million (around 21.71 billion baht) divorce payment to his former wife.

data.title: Wildfire sends hundreds fleeing French peninsula by boat
data.description: LèGE-CAP-FERRET (FRANCE) - Hundreds of people fled by boat from a peninsula in western France on Friday, as authorities ordered it evacuated in the face of a rapidly advancing wildfire.

data.title: 12 Chinese nationals arrested in Tak
